2026-11-22 root cause (BenchBox, not Polars): FormatConverter.convert_csv_to_parquet (benchbox/core/dataframe/data_loader.py) built pyarrow ConvertOptions(strings_can_be_null=True) without null_values, so pyarrow default null tokens (N/A, NA, NULL, nan, n/a) became NULL in every string column of the cached Parquet. TPC-DS item uses the literal value N/A: at SF10, 62,240 of 102,000 rows have i_size=N/A and 4,947 have i_units=N/A; all were nulled, so on streams whose Q41 binding draws N/A for SIZE or UNIT fewer manufacturers matched. Expression logic and parameter binding were correct. Evidence: dump of the registered item table vs direct load of item.dat differed only in i_size and i_units. Fix on fix/tpcds-q41-expression-row-count (035dfe6698, ae5a5133f8): null_values limited to the empty string plus the dialect null marker; DATAFRAME_CACHE_VERSION v8->v9; same cause fixed in the pandas, Dask, cuDF, DataFusion pyarrow fallback, sorted-Parquet, TPC-DI and write-primitive CSV readers, each with a test failing before and passing after. SF10 check through make heavy-run (watchdog warn, log /tmp/q41-sf10-heavy.log): polars-df expression 10/12/34/10 for streams 0-3 equals DuckDB SQL 10/12/34/10. Same-cause scan: tokens found only in TPC-DS item (i_size, i_units) and NYC Taxi taxi_zones.csv (service_zone N/A x3, zone NA x1); none in TPC-H, SSB, TPC-DI, ClickBench hits, NYC trips; JoinOrder ships Parquet. Only Q41 filters on i_size/i_units; Q24 groups by them: SF3 via make heavy-run, Q24b 1/2/0/2 equals DuckDB; SF10 polars Q24 refused by the memory guard. Every DataFrame platform reading the old v8 cache saw the nulled columns. Note: the first SF10 runs of this investigation were made outside make heavy-run (rule breach, reported); the confirming run above went through the lock.

description: At SF10 on the same generated data, polars-df (expression family) returns 10 rows for TPC-DS Q41 stream 1 and 9 rows for stream 3, while DuckDB SQL returns 12 and 10. Streams 2 and every other TPC-DS query agree. The count is identical on Polars 1.31.0, 1.44.2 and 2.0.0 (default and in-memory engines), so it is not a Polars-version effect; it comes from the expression implementation or its stream parameter binding (benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/queries.py q41_expression_impl, _q41_parameters, parameter_adapters.py). The SF0.1 cross-surface gate does not catch it. Find the cause, fix it, and add a regression that compares Q41 row counts with SQL on a bound non-default stream.
